newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: CHG share issues disallowed by Commission.
newsitem.headline: CHG share issues disallowed by Commission.

text.p: Malaysian office equipment maker CHG Industries Bhd's proposed rights issues has been disallowed by the country's regulator, the Securities Commission. "Further to our announcement on December 4, 1996, Amanah Merchant Bank Bhd on behalf of CHG wishes to announce that the Securities Commission has not approved the issues," said the company's merchant bankers in a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange. In 1996, CHG had proposed a rights issue of 97.44 million shares priced at 2.50 ringgit, on the basis of seven new shares for every five held. Amanah Merchant Bank said CHG intends to appeal to the commission against the decision. No reason was given for the disapproval. -- Kuala Lumpur newsroom (603-206 2323)
